params.title: Payroll GL post
params.note: payroll-glpost-shillinq (2026-07-12): a PayrollGLPost is hrmq's log of ONE handoff attempt into shillinq's JournalEntry register -- never the journal itself (design.md D1). TimesheetDetail/PensionFilingDetail split: pg-status leads top-left with the prominent outcome facts (status/postedAt/errorMessage), pg-related sits top-right to resolve and link the referenced PayrollRun (a real $ref, unlike journalEntryId), then pg-data runs below with the remaining record fields including the journalNumber/journalEntryId pointer into shillinq (plain display only -- no cross-app deep link in MVP, per design.md's 'posted != materialised' risk note) and the lines snapshot. NO lifecycleActions: status has no x-openregister-lifecycle transition map -- PayrollGLPostService drives every transition server-side from `occ hrmq:glpost:run`, exactly the PayrollRunDetail precedent (never invent a user-facing transition the backend does not guard). No Files/calendar/comms leaves -- this is a system-generated audit record, not a document or event. Audit history is a sidebar tab.
